what: What the design site's Vehicles review page shows for this car (R126). tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs turns this, vehicle.json, the bake and assets/profiles/<id>.json into art/ui/poc/vehicles/<id>/; tools/vehicles/review/check.mjs fails if any Vehicles-contract item is missing. Paths are repo-relative.
name: AU Hawk
summary: Reference refinement: the AU Hawk keeps its broad teardrop headlamps, oval fish-mouth grille, tall glasshouse and rounded sedan body. The arch crowns now follow the original flank roll; the lower nose supports its bumper slot. Lamps lie on the actual body facets. Lean five-spoke silver wheels at close/medium distance and plain distant discs retain the faceted style. Original colliders, hinges, anchors and handling are preserved. Exported triangles: 2104 / 874 / 600 against 3000 / 900 / 600 budgets. The reference sheets include a wing; the deliberate base-sedan no-wing interpretation is retained. Owner review decides recognisability.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: Unchanged generated reference sheets. Each comparison shows reference, revised render and silhouette diff through frozen shared perspective cameras (50m front/rear, 10m side/top, horizontal optical axis). Before/after and local reference contours/lamp envelopes are recorded in validation.md. Generated views are not calibrated photographs; measured regressions are disclosed.

damage.note: Left to right: intact; door_FL and door_RL loose; front and back loose; wheel_FL cambered; front detached; door_FL detached; back detached; wheel_FL detached; both front doors and the back detached; a stripped shell.
